latest_release.name: v0.3.17.252432
latest_release.body:
## Security
This release fixes several security vulnerabilities, including high severity issues. All security fixes are also available as patches to the previous release, v0.3.16.252432, see [v0.3.16.1.252432](https://github.com/microg/GmsCore/releases/tag/v0.3.16.1.252432).  To date, we are not aware of these security vulnerabilities being exploited in the wild. Thanks @Fs00, @SohelParashar and @p1gp1g for reporting these issues.

## What's Changed
- Maps:
  - Improve location in Huawei Maps (#3700). Thanks @DaVinci9196.
  - Add support for tile overlays (#3685). Thanks @jonathanklee.
- Location:
  - Fix speed calculation for sub-second location updates (#3737). Thanks @DaVinci9196.
  - Fix Google location settings redirect (#3588). Thanks @DaVinci9196.
  - Fix geocode provider error message (#3730). Thanks @luk1337.
  - Fix security issues.
- Fido:
  - Accept lowercase hybrid QR URI scheme (#3636). Thanks @Jadeiin.
  - Fix screen-lock exclude credential check (#3752). Thanks @adamcparsons.
  - Fix security issues.
- DroidGuard: Fix service call proxy (#3711). Thanks @DaVinci9196.
- Play Integrity: 
  - Fix interface definition (#3725). Thanks @jonathanklee.
  - Fix security issues.
- Phenotype: Update features (#3679, #3690). Thanks @DaVinci9196.
- Age Signals: Add dummy services (#3742). Thanks @DaVinci9196.
- Home: Add dummy service (#3712). Thanks @DaVinci9196.
- GCM: Fix security issues.
- Asset Modules: Fix security issues.
- SMS Retriever: Fix concurrency exception (#3626). Thanks @DaVinci9196.
- Settings: Read defaults from the bundled partition (#3394). Thanks @DaVinci9196.
- Auth:
  - Improve reauth handling when requesting auth tokens (#3448). Thanks @TheScarastic.
  - Fix security issues.
- In App Purchases:
  - Fix protocol issues (#3684). Thanks @DaVinci9196.
  - Fix callback issues (#3729). Thanks @DaVinci9196.
  - Fix payment card switching (#3649). Thanks. @DaVinci9196.
  - Fix security issues.
- Grant privileged service access to Google Passwords app (#3623). Thanks @DaVinci9196.
- New/Updated translations for Croatian, German, Burmese, Turkish, Hungarian, French, Chinese (Traditional), Arabic, Icelandic, Spanish, Finnish, Polish, Portuguese, Azerbaijani, Malay, Chinese (Simplified), Japanese, Uyghur. Thanks @marin-19, @Lamdarer, @mgminkh3nthyu, @oersen, @mdvhimself, @Atalanttore, @Mickmick21, @Sup-25498, @sveinki, @Arno313, @ciaparittolen-hub, @kolenda88, @rehork, @ReduxFlakes, @Jacob7179, @shuuji3, @AbduqadirAbliz, @tooclassyforthisworld and unnamed Weblate translators.
- Full Changelog: https://github.com/microg/GmsCore/compare/v0.3.16.252432...v0.3.17.252432

## New Contributors
- @luk1337 made their first contribution in https://github.com/microg/GmsCore/pull/3730
- @Jadeiin made their first contribution in https://github.com/microg/GmsCore/pull/3636
- @muvaf made their first contribution in https://github.com/microg/GmsCore/pull/3731
- @adamcparsons made their first contribution in https://github.com/microg/GmsCore/pull/3752
- @abranson made their first contribution in https://github.com/microg/GmsCore/pull/3394
- @TheScarastic made their first contribution in https://github.com/microg/GmsCore/pull/3448

## Release artifacts
- Users on devices with an aftermarket custom operating system ("Custom ROM") that supports microG should install `com.google.android.gms-250932034.apk` and `com.android.vending-84022634.apk`. These versions are also distributed through the microG F-Droid repository.
- Users on Huawei devices running original operating system (EMUI or HarmonyOS) that supports microG should install `com.google.android.gms-250932034-hw.apk` and `com.android.vending-84022634-hw.apk`. These versions are also distributed through Huawei AppGallery.
- `org.microg.gms-250932034-user.apk` is a development preview for special situations. Do not use it except if you know why.
